page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture and is equipped with 31.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.75 GB per core, positioning it for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity.

This instance type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, the c4d-highmem-4 does not feature any integrated GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning workloads. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make this instance a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk performance or GPU acceleration. Suitable workloads include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and general-purpose tasks requiring more than the standard 4 GB of RAM per vCPU.
